ayahs.ar: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
ayahs.en: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an
ayahs.e2: Qãf. By the glorious Quran
ayahs.tr: Qaaaf; wal Qur aanil Majeed

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.en: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing
ayahs.e2: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing
ayahs.tr: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ اۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return
ayahs.e2: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”
ayahs.tr: A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
ayahs.en: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record
ayahs.e2: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record
ayahs.tr: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرࣲ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.en: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition
ayahs.e2: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state
ayahs.tr: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts
ayahs.e2: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless
ayahs.tr: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind
ayahs.e2: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—
ayahs.tr: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej

ayahs.ar: تَبۡصِرَةࣰ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدࣲ مُّنِيبࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ مُّبَٰرَكࣰ ا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
ayahs.en: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.e2: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest
ayahs.tr: Wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتࣲ لَّهَا طَلۡعࣱ نَّضِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers
ayahs.e2: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit
ayahs.tr: Wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed

ayahs.ar: رِّزۡقࣰ ا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
ayahs.en: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection
ayahs.e2: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺
ayahs.tr: Rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
ayahs.e2: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd
ayahs.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wa Ashaabur Rassi wa Samood

ayahs.ar: وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
ayahs.e2: ’Ȃd, Pharaoh, the kinfolk of Lot
ayahs.tr: Wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot

ayahs.ar: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲۚ كُلࣱّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.en: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled
ayahs.e2: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled
ayahs.tr: Wa Ashaabul Aykati wa qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed

ayahs.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation
ayahs.e2: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation
ayahs.tr: Afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
ayahs.en: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
ayahs.e2: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left
ayahs.e2: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺
ayahs.tr: Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed

ayahs.ar: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record]
ayahs.e2: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺
ayahs.tr: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid
ayahs.e2: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape
ayahs.tr: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.en: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat
ayahs.e2: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of
ayahs.tr: Wa nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقࣱ وَشَهِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness
ayahs.e2: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify
ayahs.tr: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”
ayahs.tr: Laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.en: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared
ayahs.e2: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed

ayahs.ar: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.en: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever
ayahs.tr: Alqiyaa fee Jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed

ayahs.ar: مَّنَّاعࣲ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدࣲ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.en: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter
ayahs.e2: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter
ayahs.tr: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.en: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment
ayahs.e2: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”
ayahs.tr: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed

ayahs.ar: ۞قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.en: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error
ayahs.e2: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning
ayahs.e2: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning
ayahs.tr: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed

ayahs.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
ayahs.en: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants
ayahs.e2: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”
ayahs.tr: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.en: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more
ayahs.e2: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”
ayahs.tr: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed

ayahs.ar: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.en: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far
ayahs.e2: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off
ayahs.tr: Wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظࣲ‏
ayahs.en: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
ayahs.e2: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—
ayahs.tr: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez

ayahs.ar: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبࣲ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.en: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance]
ayahs.e2: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺
ayahs.tr: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb

ayahs.ar: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمࣲۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ
ayahs.en: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity
ayahs.e2: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”
ayahs.tr: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood

ayahs.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more
ayahs.e2: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more
ayahs.tr: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.en: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape
ayahs.e2: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape
ayahs.tr: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind]
ayahs.e2: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear
ayahs.tr: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob

ayahs.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
ayahs.en: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting
ayahs.e2: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset
ayahs.tr: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.en: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration
ayahs.e2: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers
ayahs.tr: Wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood

ayahs.ar: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانࣲ قَرِيبࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near
ayahs.e2: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place
ayahs.tr: Wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
ayahs.en: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves]
ayahs.e2: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺
ayahs.tr: Yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.e2: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return
ayahs.tr: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرࣱ‏
ayahs.en: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us
ayahs.e2: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us
ayahs.tr: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer

ayahs.ar: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارࣲۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.en: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat
ayahs.e2: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning
ayahs.tr: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed
